info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Underwriting Listing API provides users with access to detailed information about mortgage loans that are currently undergoing the underwriting process. This API allows financial institutions and mortgage professionals to retrieve a comprehensive list of mortgage loans, enabling them to monitor and manage their underwriting pipeline effectively. Typical consumers of this API include loan officers, underwriters, and mortgage analysts who require timely insights into the status of loan applications. With this API, stakeholders can make informed decisions based on real-time data related to loan underwriting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current underwriting status for loans. It provides insights into whether the loan is still being processed, has been approved, or denied. This information is crucial for both lenders and borrowers to understand the loan progress.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the parameters required for initiating the loan underwriting process. The request must contain the necessary details in JSON format as specified in the schema.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.title: Underwriting Request Body
ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loans underwriting. The request body is expected to be a string containing relevant underwriting parameters.

status.description: Indicates whether the underwriting process was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the loan application.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the underwriting result.

state.description: The current state of the underwriting process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the underwriting in milliseconds.

message.description: A message related to the underwriting process, which may contain details or instructions.

audit.description: Contains audit information regarding the underwriting process.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response for the loan underwriting operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit record was generated automatically.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit information related to the underwriting process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time in milliseconds that the server took to complete the request.
